goal: Find software progress, revision guidance, honest run instructions and Work history without accidentally starting or changing an application.

assertions.name: Show build progress opens Software without creating a task.
Existing-app edit shows explicit revision instructions and preserves exact text without applying or submitting it.
Open my app explains the source/README path without claiming a launch.
Show tasks reaches Work history; navigation produces no build, revision, chat or goal mutations.

limitations: Installed Chrome with desktop/touch emulation; no physical handset or native voice quality claim.
No test-supplied inference, API seeding, model download or external provisioning.

runtime.speech: Streaming Pocket TTS with local LavaSR enhancement
